# TA Services

TA Services is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. TA Services is a 3PL logistics provider that delivers peak performance across freight brokerage, managed transportation, warehousing & fulfillment, and cross-border logistics. TA Services employs 532 people (+4.5% YoY, +23 people) and has an annual revenue of $700M, founded in 1986. Headquartered in Mansfield, Texas, United States, with presence in Mexico. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Canada, and Mexico.

## About

𝗣𝗲𝗮𝗸 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗱.

With 𝟮𝟬+ 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗳𝗮𝗰𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀 spanning the US, Canada, and Mexico, and an elite network of carrier partners, we don’t just move freight—we 𝗼𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘇𝗲, 𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗺𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗱𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘀 with a champion mindset. Our 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺-𝗱𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 is built on trust, innovation, and the pursuit of excellence.

From first mile to final destination, we push boundaries to keep your business moving forward. 𝙇𝙚𝙩’𝙨 𝙙𝙚𝙡𝙞𝙫𝙚𝙧 𝙥𝙚𝙖𝙠 𝙥𝙚𝙧𝙛𝙤𝙧𝙢𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚 𝙩𝙤𝙜𝙚𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙧.
